blocks.text: WUHAN, China — Zheng Qinwen withdrew from the Wuhan Open citing a shoulder injury on Monday, a day after winning her first WTA title in two years and then celebrating with a bit of karaoke for the crowd at the China Open. Olympic gold medalist Zheng and French Open champion Mirra Andreeva, who lost to their China Open final 7-5, 6-4 on Sunday, both withdrew from the 1,000-level event in Wuhan. “Since returning from injury … I have played a demanding stretch of tennis over the past month and a half, competing at the US Open, the Billie Jean King Cup, […]...
